title: Smart Dimension Annotation
description: Smart dimension: creates the dimension type that matches the selections. Create only; the result is exported, edited and deleted as that dimension type.

selections.description: Ordered selections. Three selections create a three-point angular dimension, with the vertex first. A single point selection is rejected.

textPosition.description: Text position of the dimension. Determines the orientation or side of the created dimension.

drivingValue.description: Value of the created dimension when it drives its geometry, in the units of its measurement (radians for an angle). Rejected when the dimension does not drive its geometry.

selection.title: Smart Dimension Selection
selection.description: Selection: an edge or a point.
